visible_text:
The Baker University women’s rugby team will play in
the national championship for the first time in 25 years.
The team secured its spot last week with a decisive 32–12
victory over Ridgefield College. Head coach Sara Okoye, a former
national champion herself, led the team through months of intensive
training. Key players including emerging talent Alejandra Ortiz and
veteran team members contributed to the win.
The championship match is on November 11 at Springfield Stadium.
The university is offering free shuttle transportation to the game, and
students can attend by presenting their ID cards.
Campus enthusiasm is growing in anticipation of the event. A pep
rally scheduled for November 9 will give fans an opportunity to meet
the players and receive complimentary gear.
Team captain Maria Patel stated, “This is our biggest achievement in a
quarter century. We are playing for the entire Baker community and
everyone who has supported us.”
